project.title: Serum-microdroplet enrichment of wastewater bacteria from urban wastewater treatment plants
project.description: This project investigates host-adapted bacteria in municipal wastewater recovered through a microfluidic serum-microdroplet enrichment method (Capture-Enrich), in which wastewater bacteria are encapsulated in human serum droplets to select for serum-tolerant, host-adapted organisms. Data were collected from influent at two wastewater treatment plants and comprise two components: (1) 16S rRNA gene amplicon sequences profiling bacterial community composition across serial enrichment passages, and (2) whole-genome sequences of serum-tolerant isolates, sequenced on the Oxford Nanopore platform with medaka-polished assemblies.
